final_selection.performance_retention_gate: relative to sealed C1 at 100000, pooled P47 mean return and success are each no more than 0.10 lower; neither metric is more than 0.20 lower in any paired training seed
final_selection.safety_efficacy_gate: relative to continued C0 at 200000, pooled P47 mean cost and CVaR-20 are each at least 10 percent lower and each metric is lower in at least two of three paired training seeds
final_selection.safety_retention_gate: relative to sealed C1 at 100000, pooled P47 mean cost and CVaR-20 are each no more than 10 percent higher
final_selection.training_safety_gate: relative to continued C0 at 200000, pooled P47 cumulative training cost is at least 10 percent lower and is lower in at least two of three paired training seeds
final_selection.freeze_C1: freeze the existing C1 configuration if P47 fails any locked gate
final_selection.freeze_P47: freeze P47 only if it passes every locked gate

analysis.reporting: always report every arm-by-training-seed result, pooled formal values, complete common-protocol checkpoint curves, Pareto plots, and both high-risk geometry diagnostics
analysis.selection_evidence: only the independent 5-base-seed by 20-episode formal evaluation at the final checkpoint enters the locked selection gates

checkpoints.C0_resume_state: model, every optimizer, both duals, observation normalizer, counters, warmup, full replay, cumulative training cost, held-out evidence, and RNG state

evaluation.common_randomness: for each base seed, seed the isolated environment once, then run 20 sequential resets from that environment RNG stream; one local CPU flow generator seeded by flow_seed_offset plus the base seed continues across all 20 episodes
evaluation.flow_randomness: uniform[-1,1] base actions followed by standard-normal Wiener increments from the same local CPU generator

formal.role: the only evaluation used for final selection

geometry_diagnostics.dangerous_outward_velocity: positive_part(n_C^T u_theta) from raw learned midpoint velocity before reference noise and action clipping
geometry_diagnostics.ranking: descending local normalized Q-cost budget margin with a stable original-order tie break
geometry_diagnostics.role: diagnostic only and never a selection gate
geometry_diagnostics.variance_ratio: V_N divided by V_T on exactly the same selected midpoint samples

method.directional_loss_velocity: raw learned midpoint velocity before stochastic reference noise and action clipping
method.shared_control: the identical r_C tensor controls both directional-loss numerator and fixed-trace normal diffusion
method.tau_C_source: reuse the sealed P4.5/P4.6 cost_geometry_bandwidth; no new tuned hyperparameter

objective: retain the demonstrated direction-mechanism safety benefit
make rare risky samples contribute in proportion to their actual batch prevalence
remove direct gradient incentive to inflate tangent or total velocity
activate anisotropic diffusion continuously on the dangerous side
freeze one final PointGoal method after this experiment

post_P47.next_stage: freeze the selected P47 or C1 configuration, then run the SHAPO four-environment formal experiment with five training seeds per environment

training.concurrency: one RTX3090 with at most four single-environment processes
